articles.title: Did prediction markets call the U.S. midterm election?: State of Crypto
articles.summary: Prediction markets and polls largely aligned by the end of the 2026 election cycle, and both had notable misses.

articles.title: XRP crashes to its lowest since November 2024 as money leaves crypto
